'''Urlik''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Valahari/Legends|Valahari]] who lived during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He was killed by a [[Unidentified Mon Calamari Jedi|Mon Calamari Jedi]] during the [[Battle of Valahari]].
